description: Contract Information Extractor helps ChatGPT organize information explicitly stated in user-supplied contract text. It extracts contract metadata, existing clauses, party obligations, deliverables, deadlines, and dependencies into structured results. It does not assess legality, validity, fairness, enforceability, or legal risk, and it does not provide legal advice or recommend contract changes.
